messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "risk is particularly high in the first few months of treatment"
set: ["risk is particularly high in the first few months of treatment", "risk is high when the dose is changed", "risk especially high in child", "risk in people with high blood pressure", "risk especially high in people using without prescription", "heartburn is often confused with the first symptoms of a heart attack", "hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase risk of high blood pressure in pregnancy", "risk of addiction", "risk of overdose", "risk of death", "may increase risk of complications in newborn", "increased risk of seizures in certain conditions", "risk is especially high if you have a history of depression, mental illness, or bipolar disorder", "risk of suicidal thoughts in young people", "stopping treatment is not automatically safer", "breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
